title: GlobalBench: A Benchmark for Global Progress in Natural Language Processing
reasoning: The paper's core design philosophy and evaluation metrics are centered around promoting 'equitable language technologies that serve speakers of all languages throughout the world' and measuring 'utility' and 'equity' of systems across languages. It aims to identify and reward progress on 'under-served languages', which directly addresses ethical considerations related to fairness and access in NLP development. This goes beyond a standard ethical considerations section, as it's a fundamental aspect of the benchmark's purpose and design.
